name: Superteam India Community Call [2026]
description:
Superteam is a network of operators, devs & grantees working on promising Solana projects.

Simply put, it is a gated Slack Workspace for those who satisfy the membership criteria. There’s no treasury, take-rate/commissions, or token sale. From its inception, Superteam has chosen to be a collective of sovereigns over a sovereign collective. Any revenue generated is captured by the individual members or teams that self-organize and win a bounty, and secure a grant or venture funding for their ideas.

The community is the product. And members have exclusive access to the product.

Our community call is the one time every week when Superteam India members get together to,

celebrate wins

share project updates & demos

find teammates or ask for help

hear from the occasional guest speakers

get updates, alpha & news you can use about Superteam & the wider Solana ecosystem

Every Thursday, 6pm. Join us!

 Who should attend? 
 Pre-seed to Series B Tech Startups. 
 Looking at the investors joining us in September, here's where their attention seems to be for this cohort 
 ▪️ Physical AI — robotics, sensors, industrial automation, and the machines reshaping manufacturing, construction, and mobility. 
 ▪️ Semiconductors and AI chips — the silicon underneath all of it.

 ▪️ Health tech and biotech — health and wellness, digital health care solutions, pharma production, oncology, and medical devices. 
 ▪️ Climate and energy — adaptation and resilience, clean energy, electrification, batteries, and transportation. 
 ▪️ AI, across the whole stack — infrastructure, enterprise, application layer, AI-ready data, and the work of making it safe and interpretable.

name: The Hitchhiker’s Guide to Silicon Valley Ft. Kim Kolt & Brian Mac Mahon
description:
The Hitchhiker’s Guide to Silicon Valley: A Founder’s Playbook for Building the Future 
 Join us as we feature the delicious brains of investors Kim Kolt (GP, Bay Bridge Ventures) and Brian Mac Mahon (Director, Nathan Family Office) for an unfiltered, candid conversation on what it actually takes to navigate today's shifting landscape. Forget the polished PR narratives—this session exposes the hard realities of building, funding, and exiting tech companies in the current macro climate. 
 Key Discussion Topics 
 New Vehicles for Liquidity: How public markets are evolving and why Private Equity is swallowing VC, forcing founders to build for PE roll-ups and distressed AI exits instead of public listings. 
 
 Global Innovation Pitfalls: A direct look at regulation, capital efficiency, and why regions like the EU continue to struggle to foster high-growth tech ecosystems. 
 
 Cutting Through the Noise: How seasoned investors spot the fine line between a true visionary and a charismatic BS'er in under five minutes. 
 
 Investor Blindspots & Myths: The metrics and pitch deck elements founders obsess over that investors actually ignore when making real check-writing decisions. 
 
 The Silicon Valley Love-Hate Paradox: Why top investors and founders still flock to the Bay Area despite its glaring flaws, expensive overhead, and high friction. 

 Event Details 
 Date & Time: Sept 11 at 5:00PM -Private Dinner at 7:30pm 
 
 Location: The Park James Hotel, Menlo Park, CA 
 
 Speakers: Kim Kolt (Bay Bridge Ventures) & Brian Mac Mahon (Nathan Family Office) 

 Huge thanks to our sponsors:

name: XRPL Lending Protocol Hackathon
description:

 You will build on the Lending Protocol (XLS-66) and Single Asset Vault (XLS-65): ship a prototype, and file structured feedback on the tooling and docs (Client libraries gaps, UX friction, missing primitives, tutorials).  Apply. Ship. Leave feedback that can benefit to the whole ecosystem.

name: AI x Crypto: Innovation, Efficiency and Staying Safe in a New Digital Economy
description:
AI x Crypto: Innovation, Efficiency and Staying Safe in a New Digital Economy 
 Artificial intelligence is rapidly reshaping the crypto and blockchain landscape, moving beyond basic automation into smart research, dynamic risk management, and adaptive trading tools that can help users process information and navigate increasingly complex digital markets. 
 However, operating at the speed of AI presents a fresh set of challenges. Fast execution, complex automated tools, and shifting market environments mean users need to understand not just the opportunities, but how to navigate potential technical limits and emerging risks safely. 
 Join this educational discussion to explore the opportunities and challenges at the intersection of AI and crypto. We will look at how AI is transforming the sector, what users should be aware of, and the practical steps everyone can take to use emerging tools more safely and responsibly. 
 Discussion Topics 
 How AI is transforming crypto: The role of AI in blockchain products, user experiences, data analysis, customer support, security monitoring and operational efficiency. 
 
 New products and opportunities: How AI-enabled tools are changing the way people interact with wallets, decentralised applications, market information and digital-asset platforms. 
 
 Efficiency and automation: Where AI can help simplify complex processes, improve access to information and support better decision-making. 
 
 Understanding Tool Capabilities & Limits: Knowing what AI can and cannot do 
 
 Responsible Adoption & Oversight: Building the core financial knowledge and critical-thinking habits needed to guide AI tools safely, rather than relying on them blindly. 

 Schedule: 
 6.30pm - Welcome, registration and check in 
 
 7.15pm - Fireside chat

name: Bitcoin 203: Multi-Sig Transactions: Securing Your Bitcoin with Multiple Keys
description: Looking for the ultimate in Bitcoin security? Locking your bitcoin with multiple keys is a simple, effective solution! Bitcoin educator and Space member, Tim McTavish, will teach you how to easily create your own multi-sig solution using Sparrow Wallet. No third-party needed! During this session, we will create a 2-of-3 multi-sig using three keys from participants. We will send ~$20 USD worth of bitcoin to this wallet. From there, we will randomly select a participant to receive this bitcoin. We will then execute a 2-of-3 signature, sending the bitcoin from our multi-sig to this lucky participant! What you'll learn: What is a multi-sig? Why and when should I use multi-sig? How do you best manage multi-sig keys? What is a PSBT file and how/when might I use it? What to bring (optional): A "receive" address in case you are the lucky winner of $20 worth of bitcoin! Your laptop with Sparrow Wallet installed Your signing device Agenda: Doors open: 530pm Discussion: 6pm - 7pm Discussion/Q&A: 7pm - 8pm Drinks will be provided

name: WoCS Austin X Cloudflare: The Forward Deployed Era + CS's Shift to Revenue
description:
About Event 
 A new role is showing up on org charts across tech, and it's quietly taking the work that used to define the CSM seat. 
 The Forward Deployed Engineer is now hands-on with implementation and technical delivery in a way that used to sit with Customer Success. As that work moves off the CSM's plate, the CSM seat isn't disappearing, it's being redefined. 
 That is the real shift, and it is what this evening is about. When technical delivery is no longer how you prove your value, that value has to show up somewhere else, and more and more that somewhere is the number: the renewal, the expansion, the growth of the account. So the questions get practical fast. What do you hand off? What do you hold onto? And how do you build the language and instincts of someone who owns revenue, even if your title does not say so yet? 
 This time you'll hear from both sides of that handoff: a Forward Deployed Engineer who can tell you exactly what the role owns and why it exists, and a senior Cloudflare Customer Success leader whose team recently brought FDEs into the org, so she has lived what changes for CS when that work moves. The evening moves from fireside chat into small-group roundtable conversations, so every attendee leaves with a specific next step for wherever they sit in this shift. 
 As always, bites and beverages will be provided 🍽️ 
 Fireside Chat Speakers 
 What We'll Dive Into 
 What a Forward Deployed Engineer actually does, and how it differs from a Technical Account Manager or Sales Engineer 
 
 What changes when technical delivery splits off from the CSM seat, and why this is happening industry-wide at the same time 
 
 Who owns the technical build or deployment now, and what CSMs are starting to own instead

description:
Converge is one afternoon built to do a single thing: get every corner of crypto into the same room and pointed at the same questions. Policy, stablecoins, and AI. None of them belong to any one chain. 
 This is what ETHBoston and Solana Boston become in 2026. Same organizers, same standard, no longer split by ecosystem. 
 On stage: 
 Coinbase on x402 and agentic onchain payments 
 
 Fidelity recording the FCAT Crypto Brief live 
 
 Circle Research on privacy in payments 
 
 Blockworks Research on the Token Transparency Framework 
 
 SEC, the CFTC, and state fight over perpetuals 
 
 Allora Labs on AI, pricing, and trading digital assets 
 
 Quip on post-quantum security 
 
 Lightning talks, short-format pitches from builders across the afternoon 
 
 Groma on real estate tokenization 
 
 A policy panel on market structure legislation and what passes before the midterms 
 
 More to come! 

 Three questions worth an afternoon 
 Stablecoins. The most boring and most consequential thing in crypto. Payment rails, treasury operations, bank integration, and what actually changes when dollars settle instantly and globally by default. Boston has a real claim on this one. 
 AI. Agents are starting to hold keys, move value, and make decisions without a human in the loop. Agentic finance is the part of the AI story that runs on crypto rails, and it is arriving well ahead of the frameworks built for it. 
 Policy. Market structure legislation is moving and the midterms are months away. The rules being written right now decide what everyone else in the room is allowed to build. We are putting candidates, officeholders, counsel, and advocates into sessions with the founders they regulate. 
 Additional programming spans DeFi, security, infrastructure, and market structure.

description:

 (English Below)

 PERP DEX DAY.

 본 이벤트는 승인 전용 행사이며, 정원은 600명 한정입니다. 신청자가 정원을 초과할 경우 ReboundX 터미널 / 리베이트 사용 유저가 우선 선정됩니다.

 행사 중 촬영된 사진·영상이 이벤트 홍보 및 SNS에 사용될 수 있음을 양해해 주시는 것으로 간주됩니다. 

 🗓️ 일시: 2026년 9월 28일 월요일

 🔮 About ReboundX 
 크립토 시장은 늘 트레이딩으로 귀결되며, 트레이딩에는 항상 수수료가 발생합니다. ReboundX는 이러한 수수료를 단순한 비용이 아닌 새로운 기회로 바꾸기 위해, 주요 CEX와 Perp DEX를 아우르는 최고 수준의 리베이트 플랫폼으로 시작했습니다. 거래가 발생하는 즉시 리베이트가 계산되며, 24시간 이내 자동 정산됩니다. 현재 ReboundX는 리베이트 플랫폼을 넘어 트레이딩 터미널이자 DEX·CEX 애그리게이터로 진화하고 있습니다. 다양한 거래소를 하나의 인터페이스에서 연결하여, 트레이더들이 모든 거래에서 더 많은 가치를 돌려받을 수 있는 통합 트레이딩 허브를 구축하고 있습니다. 
 🤝 About Sponsors 
 2024년 전체 무기한 선물 시장의 약 2%에 불과했던 Perp DEX는 2025년 한 해 동안 거래량이 4.3배 성장하며, 사상 최초로 월간 거래량 $1T를 돌파했습니다. 
 2026년에는 CEX 거래량이 30% 이상 감소하는 상황에서도 성장을 이어가며, 전체 파생상품 시장의 10% 이상을 차지하는 구조적인 시장 축 으로 자리잡았습니다. 최고점에서는 시장 점유율이 24%까지 치솟았습니다. 
 이는 단순한 일시적 트렌드를 넘어, 트레이더들이 중앙화거래소(CEX) 대신 Perp DEX를 선택하는 수요가 본격적으로 자리잡고 있음을 보여줍니다.

name: Blockchain & Stablecoins are Rebuilding the Payment Stack
description:
The Big Whale is the leading Market Intelligence provider on Digital Assets, serving 150+ institutional & corporate clients across banks, asset managers, fintechs and digital asset companies. 
 Join TBW , Payward Services , DFNS , 21X , Société Générale Forge , and BNP Paribas (AssetFoundry) for an exclusive breakfast in Miami during Sibos! 
 The payments stack has been under pressure for years. Correspondent banking is expensive and slow. Cross-border rails remain opaque. And the promise of real-time, low-cost global transfers has largely stayed out of reach. 
 Blockchain infrastructure and stablecoins are now offering an alternative. Not as a disruption from outside, but increasingly as a layer that banks, PSPs, and fintechs are building into their own architectures. 
 During this exclusive morning, we'll bring together banks, PSPs, trade finance players and fintechs to examine where this rebuild is already happening, what it takes to integrate blockchain and stablecoin infrastructure at scale, and who the real winners of the new payment stack will be. 
 Thanks to Payward Services, SG Forge, 21X, BNP Paribas, and DFNS for making this event possible. Attending? Share your presence with a dedicated visual here!

name: P.S. Lisbon
description:
Lisbon has always been a city for the people who explore and build. Following that same spirit, INPUT, Paybis and nSureAI are bringing together the founders, investors and operators reshaping iGaming and payments, for an evening in Alfama, the oldest neighbourhood in Lisbon. 
 October 1st, at La Distillerie, a 19th century distillery at the heart of the neighbourhood. Music, Portuguese wine, and the kind of company worth writing home about. 
 What to expect 
 Founders, investors, and leaders from across iGaming and payments 
 
 Portuguese wine tasting led by a sommelier 
 
 Cocktails and canapés throughout 
 
 DJ set through the night 
 
 Postcard Corner: pick a card, write something worth sending, and drop it in the box. It gets stamped and mailed straight to your door. 
 
 A relaxed evening, no agenda, no panels, just good company 

 The venue 
 La Distillerie sits at the heart of Alfama, Lisbon's oldest neighbourhood. A 19th century distillery, high ceilings, stone walls, authentic Portuguese details. 
 Co-hosted by Paybis 
 Paybis makes crypto simple for individuals and enterprises. Established in 2014, the company combines a trusted crypto exchange and wallet—to buy, sell, swap and hold over 90 cryptocurrencies—with award-winning crypto-fiat infrastructure. This infrastructure empowers businesses to transfer capital globally, eliminating traditional payment friction. 
 In 2026, Paybis was recognized as the Best Crypto Payment Provider, a testament to our expansive global reach, rapid onboarding protocols, and the deep expertise of the 200 dedicated professionals who drive our operations. 
 Processing more than $6bn annually, Paybis is one of the most efficient platforms for acquiring and transacting in digital assets.

name: Monad Metropolis Hacker House: London
description:
Monad Metropolis is Monad's flagship global hackathon - six weeks, online-first, $250,000 in prizes. This is the London hacker house: one day at Encode Hub to meet other builders working on Metropolis, get your questions answered, and put real hours into your submission. 
 Metropolis runs 1 September to 13 October. Wherever you are in that window — still shaping an idea, looking for teammates, or deep in the build — this day is for you. 
 What to expect 
 Morning: around two hours of talks and workshops. A technical session run by Monad's engineering team, plus speakers on the things that decide whether a hackathon project becomes a company — go-to-market, fundraising, business model, community and hiring. 
 Rest of the day: coworking. Desks, fast wifi, coffee, and mentors on the floor.
Come with a team or find one here. 
 The Tracks 
 Onchain Finance & Trading - asset primitives and market infrastructure that only work with fast settlement. 
 Consumer Products & Payments - crypto that doesn't feel like crypto. Social payments, salary streaming, programmable gifts. 
 Social, Attention & Culture - open social graphs, attention markets, generative art, competitive feeds. 
 Trust, Identity & AI Infrastructure - primitives for an AI-native internet. Proof of personhood, content passports, data lockers. 
 Prizes 
 $250,000 total . $30,000 overall winner, $30,000 per track, plus 20+ sponsor bounties from Dynamic, Privy, Perpl, Nansen, Chainlink, Agora, Kuru, MetaMask and others. 
 Who should come 
 Developers, designers and founders building on Monad — or curious about it. Solo builders welcome; teams form on the day. You don't need prior Monad experience, but bring a laptop. 
 Registration is free and capacity is limited.

Housed within the former Supreme Court and City Hall — two national monuments that witnessed some of the defining moments in Singapore's history — the Gallery is a place where the past is preserved and new ideas continue to take shape. 
 Under the iconic Rotunda dome, historic architecture meets a soaring contemporary glass canopy — a fitting home for ZERO TO INFINITY. For this one day, this space becomes our playground for the next frontier: AI demos, ecosystem showcases, conversations, food, drinks, and the people building what comes next. 
 A place that holds history. A day to create the next chapter.

name: RWA Beyond the Hype: Industry Talks & Networking
description:
​超越热度：RWA 真正落地，还缺什么？ 
 行业分享与交流酒会 
 RWA 已经不缺关注。接下来更值得讨论的是： 真实资产如何成为用户看得懂、信得过、愿意使用的产品，并真正走向规模化？

 酒会席位有限，报名需经审核；最终入场以审核确认及现场接待容量为准。 
 如有商务合作需求，请联系： connect@bifu.co ，或telegram @takshire 
 
 时间流程: 
 20:00–20:20 嘉宾入场、欢迎酒与自由交流 2 
 20:20–20:55 开场及精选合作伙伴／项目分享 
 20:55–21:50 现场表演与自由交流、社交 
 21:50–22:00 第二轮抽奖、致谢与活动结束 
 现场嘉宾 
 RWA 与 Web3 项目的创始人及联合创始人、生态与增长负责人、交易平台及金融基础设施团队、BiFu 合作伙伴、KOL 与内容创作者、专业社群主理人，以及媒体、研究者、投资机构和新加坡 FinTech／Web3 生态参与者。 
 主办方｜Host：BiFu 
 成立于 2023 年，BiFu 是融通 Web2 与 Web3 全域资产交易的先锋级平台。 
 BiFu 是连接数字资产与更广泛全球市场的统一资产网络。我们打破传统金融边界，让用户只需一个账户，即可自由交易 Crypto、外汇、大宗商品、美港股及 RWA。凭借统一账户体系、极速稳定性能、完备合规与社区赋能，BiFu 致力于让全球优质财富走向平权，确保无论机会出现在哪个市场，用户都已「在场」。 
 ​ 关于 BiNet｜全域资产交易网络 
 BiNet 是 BiFu 打造的全域资产交易网络，也是 「One Account, Trade the World」 这句承诺的底层支撑。 
 它将加密资产、外汇、大宗商品、股票、RWA 与预测市场六大类市场整合进统一账户体系。用户只需完成一次身份认证，即可用同一个账户、同一笔资金进入全部市场。 
 在这套体系之下，BiNet 以统一身份、统一资金、统一风控、统一合规四项基础能力为骨架，辅以聚合 200 余家全球交易所的流动性网络、亚毫秒级交易引擎与智能路由，让跨市场交易像在单一市场中一样连贯、顺畅。 
 资产之间的墙正在被拆除， BiNet 要做的，就是把全球市场装进一个账户。 
 ​ 关于 BiFu 财富板块｜BiFu Wealth 
 ​RWA 的价值不只在于资产上链，更在于让普通投资者真正有机会参与其中。 
 BiFu 财富板块面向既有稳健收益诉求、又希望保留资金灵活性的用户，提供一站式资产配置入口。依托 BiNet 的统一账户与跨市场基础设施，RWA 将与加密资产、外汇、大宗商品共同构成多元资产配置体系。 
 通过将真实世界资产引入链上配置框架，财富板块让过去仅向机构开放的收益来源，逐步成为普通投资者可触达、可理解、可配置的选项。 
 让 RWA 从行业热词变成普通投资者账户里的真实持仓，这是 BiFu 财富板块对「金融平权」的回答，也是我们对「RWA 真正落地」这个命题给出的实践。 
 RWA Beyond the Hype: What Will Real Adoption Take? 
 RWA no longer lacks attention. The more important question now is how real-world assets can become products that users understand, trust, and choose to use—and how those products can reach meaningful scale.

name: The Treasury Table: A CFO Summit
description:
The Treasury Table: Stablecoins, Payments, and Business Banking 
 The way companies hold, move, and account for money is being rebuilt. Stablecoins are becoming settlement infrastructure, cross-border payments are moving from days to minutes, and the business banking stack is being redrawn around them. For the people who run finance, this is no longer a topic to watch. It is a set of decisions to make. 
 The Treasury Table is a closed-door afternoon summit for CFOs, VPs of Finance, and heads of treasury, held during TOKEN2049 Week in Singapore. One room, a curated group of finance leaders, and a focused program on the questions that sit on their desks right now. 
 Across two panels and a keynote, the conversation covers: 
 Stablecoins as treasury and settlement infrastructure, and what regulatory clarity now allows 
 
 Cross-border payments, payroll, and vendor settlement at global scale 
 
 The future of business banking: accounts, cards, and the modern finance stack 
 
 What tokenized assets and onchain cash management mean for the balance sheet 

 The format is built for substance, not pitches. Panels are led by operators and finance leaders, followed by an extended networking reception where the real conversations happen.

name: A Global Living Lab: Light DAO's Next International Gathering
description:
Members of Light DAO’s leadership recently participated in Edge Esmeralda and came away feeling it was one of the most impressive, inspiring and transformative business gatherings we had ever experienced — because it was not a conference, retreat or summit. 
 It was a Society Incubator — an extraordinary integration of worlds that are rarely found in one place. 
 In a single day, you might: 
 🌅 Begin the morning with a tea ceremony, breathwork or yoga 
 🧠 Move into a talk with brilliant researchers, founders and investors on frontier science and emerging technology 
 💻 Spend a few hours building software, testing experimental health wearables, collaborating in a maker space, or creating in a media lab 
 🌿 Head into nature, join a wellness session, or get absorbed in a discussion on the latest in AI agents, fintech or longevity 
 🍽️ Continue the conversations over dinner late into the evening — or end the night with music, ecstatic dance or a calming sound bath 
 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 For families , dedicated programs for kids and teens, starting at age 4, offer opportunities to play, learn, create and build within their own community 
 ✨ Alongside all of this are deep conversations about consciousness, philosophy, society and human flourishing 
 It felt like stepping into a living laboratory for the future — a temporary village designed to explore and experiment with how we might live, work, learn, build and thrive differently. 
 It offered a glimpse of what the world could look like when innovation, human flourishing and community are developed together. 
 This is Edge City.

description:
Join us for the London edition of the PR1ME Series , during Solana Breakpoint powered by the Onchain Finance Institute (OCF), Solana Foundation , Lukka and Breezing . 
 This invite only, community driven gathering brings together leading minds in web3 accounting and finance. 
 This event is exclusively for finance professionals - CFOs, COOs, Controllers, Heads of Finance, or equivalent. We're unable to accept applications outside these roles. 
 Important: Only confirmed guests with a QR code will be allowed entry. Please note that walk-ins or unapproved registrations will not be possible. 
 ​ About Solana Foundation 
 The Solana Foundation is a non-profit organisation based in Zug, Switzerland, dedicated to the decentralisation, growth, and security of the Solana network. Solana is a proof-of-stake blockchain built for mass adoption. Fast, composable, green, and globally distributed. 
 ​ About Lukka 
 Lukka is the institutional data backbone for digital assets, transforming fragmented on-chain and off-chain activity into audit-ready intelligence. Trusted by global financial institutions, asset managers, custodians, exchanges, and regulators, Lukka delivers the trust, truth, and transparency needed to power pricing, valuation, compliance, risk management, accounting, and reporting across digital and tokenized assets. 
 About Breezing 
 Breezing is a crypto subledger built specifically for accounting professionals managing digital assets. It connects directly to blockchains, exchanges, and accounting systems like Xero and QuickBooks, eliminating the manual work of exporting CSVs and posting journal entries by hand. 
 Used by 200+ businesses including ht.digital , BDO, ETH Global, Safe, and Dune. 
 SOC 2 certified and Swiss-made🇨🇭.

name: Cardano Node Diversity Celebration Day
description:
One network. Many builders. A stronger future. Cardano node diversity is no longer just an ambition. It is becoming real. On the 6th October in Singapore, Cardano Diversity Celebration Day will bring together representatives from Cardano’s different node implementations to share their progress, compare timelines and discuss how independent implementations can strengthen the network. The event will also introduce the Diversity Ambassador Program and invite feedback on the next phase of this collective effort. Why does this matter? Because a truly resilient blockchain should never depend on one team, one codebase or one way of solving a problem. Independent node implementations give Cardano more protection, more opportunities for innovation and more freedom to evolve. Node diversity reduces common-mode risk: when implementations are developed independently, they can reveal different edge cases, validate protocol behaviour from different perspectives. It also creates room for improvements in resource efficiency, observability, tooling and operator experience. This is not about replacing one implementation with another. It is about building complementary infrastructure—giving Cardano more resilience, more engineering options and greater confidence as the protocol evolves. Cardano Diversity Celebration Day is where the people building that future come together and where the wider community gets to see what comes next 
 The event will be broadcasted from Singapore but everyone is welcome to join us online. 
 More information about the even: https://hackmd.io/@Amaru/DiversityCelebrationDraft 
 Agenda: 
 Why diversity matters: decentralization, security and resilience

description:
Join us for an exclusive Token Sale Summit during Token2049 Singapore, designed for founders, C-suites and project leaders preparing a token sale (TGE) or rethinking their launch plan for today's market.

A successful raise now runs as one connected launch, in which the private and public rounds, TGE, exchange listings and post-listing market making each serve a distinct purpose and are planned together to support the token's success after launch day. 
 In this invite-only session, our TokenMinds expert team will share practical strategies for this new environment.

 Key Takeaways 
 Token Sale setup for 2026, including round structure (private to public route), tokenomics, whitepaper, legal framework and more 
 
 Choosing, and getting selected for, the right launchpads and platforms under today's stricter vetting and compliance 
 
 Token Sale marketing strategies for a more selective market 
 
 Post-TGE liquidity, listings & market engagement 

 Why now 
 Token sale has become more selective now. Exchanges, launchpads and regulators ask sharper questions about sale terms, token rights and unlock schedules, and retail buyers do the same. This session helps you finalize a launch plan that holds up under that scrutiny before the year-end window closes.

 RWA 项目与资产方、交易平台与多资产平台、基金／做市商／VC、财富管理机构与家族办公室、稳定币／支付／托管／安全服务商、金融基础设施团队、新加坡 FinTech 与 Web3 生态代表，以及精选媒体、研究者与专业社群。 
 主办方｜Host：BiFu 
 成立于 2023 年，BiFu 是融通 Web2 与 Web3 全域资产交易的先锋级平台。 
 BiFu 是连接数字资产与更广泛全球市场的统一资产网络。我们打破传统金融边界，让用户只需一个账户，即可自由交易 Crypto、外汇、大宗商品、美港股及 RWA。凭借统一账户体系、极速稳定性能、完备合规与社区赋能，BiFu 致力于让全球优质财富走向平权，确保无论机会出现在哪个市场，用户都已「在场」。 
 关于 BiNet｜全域资产交易网络 
 BiNet 是 BiFu 打造的全域资产交易网络，也是「One Account, Trade the World」这句承诺的底层支撑。 
 它将加密资产、外汇、大宗商品、股票、RWA 与预测市场六大类市场整合进统一账户体系。用户只需完成一次身份认证，即可用同一个账户、同一笔资金进入全部市场。 
 在这套体系之下，BiNet 以统一身份、统一资金、统一风控、统一合规四项基础能力为骨架，辅以聚合 200 余家全球交易所的流动性网络、亚毫秒级交易引擎与智能路由，让跨市场交易像在单一市场中一样连贯、顺畅。 
 资产之间的墙正在被拆除，BiNet 要做的，就是把全球市场装进一个账户。 
 关于 BiFu 财富板块｜BiFu Wealth 
 RWA 的价值不只在于资产上链，更在于让普通投资者真正有机会参与其中。 
 BiFu 财富板块面向既有稳健收益诉求、又希望保留资金灵活性的用户，提供一站式资产配置入口。依托 BiNet 的统一账户与跨市场基础设施，RWA 将与加密资产、外汇、大宗商品共同构成多元资产配置体系。 
 通过将真实世界资产引入链上配置框架，财富板块让过去仅向机构开放的收益来源，逐步成为普通投资者可触达、可理解、可配置的选项。 
 让 RWA 从行业热词变成普通投资者账户里的真实持仓，这是 BiFu 财富板块对「金融平权」的回答，也是我们对「RWA 真正落地」这个命题给出的实践。

name: The Crossing: Engineering Trust in Institutional Digital Finance
description:
An invitation-only VIP reception on the evening of TOKEN2049 Day 1, co-hosted by Safeheron, The Responsible Fintech Institute, DK Bank, Cloudflare and VerifyVASP. 
 Traditional finance is crossing to digital assets. Not as an experiment anymore, but as a route that has to work every time — for real money, under real rules. 
 No one company supplies that crossing. Between them, these five cover it end to end: 
 Safeheron — the vessel. Open-source MPC and TEE self-custody, so the keys stay yours the whole way across. 
 
 The Responsible Fintech Institute — the charts. Independent standards and published research that make the route defensible. 
 
 DK Bank — the harbour. The official bank of Bhutan’s Gelephu Mindfulness City, built for digital assets from day one. 
 
 Cloudflare — the lanes. The network it all runs over, reaching 95% of the world’s internet users in roughly 50 milliseconds. 
 
 VerifyVASP — the manifest. Travel Rule at institutional scale: who is on the other end, verified before the value moves. 

 Five claims, and every one of them checkable. 
 Then drinks, canapés, and three hours with everyone else who is somewhere mid-crossing. 
 Places are limited. Request your invitation early. 
 About Hosts 
 Safeheron 
 Safeheron is the world's leading digital asset self-custody provider. Built on fully in-house developed, open-source Secure Multi-Party Computation (MPC) and Trusted Execution Environment (TEE) technologies, Safeheron delivers institutional-grade self-custody infrastructure and industry-specific solutions at the highest security standards.

name: The Institutional Table: Private Dinner on Tokenization, Stablecoins and Se
description:
21 seats. One table. No panel, no pitch deck. 
 The Institutional Table is a private, invite-only dinner hosted by QuillAudits on the closing night of Token2049 Singapore. Banks, asset managers, funds, exchanges, custodians, tokenization platforms and stablecoin issuers, in one room, talking about what it actually takes to put regulated assets on public chains without getting burned. 
 What we will talk about 
 Tokenization at scale: what breaks when a fund, bond or money market structure moves on-chain. ERC-3643, ERC-4626 vaults, NAV oracles, transfer restrictions and the compliance layer around them. Lessons from Project Guardian pilots going to production. 
 Stablecoins as payment rails: MAS-regulated issuance, reserve attestations, mint and burn controls, blacklist and freeze functions, and where issuers have been exploited. 
 The institutional security bar: what a board, a regulator and a counterparty should be able to ask for before capital moves. Audits, formal verification, monitoring, key management, incident response. 
 What went wrong in 2026: a closed-door walk through the year's institutional-grade incidents, and what each one should have caught earlier. 
 Format 
 Seated dinner for 21. Short opening from QuillAudits, then moderated conversation under Chatham House rules. No recording, no press, no slides. 
 Who is at the table 
 Heads of digital assets, treasury and product at banks and asset managers. Founders and CxOs of tokenization platforms and stablecoin issuers. Fund partners with RWA and stablecoin exposure. Regulators and policy leads by invitation. 
 Seats are confirmed personally. Registering here is a request, not a confirmation. Venue in the Marina Bay area, shared with confirmed guests. 
 About QuillAudits 
 8+ years securing Web3.
